description: Implementation of TestCookieAccessDelegate class for cookie access and first-party set management in Chromium project.

classes.name: TestCookieAccessDelegate
classes.description: A class providing cookie access semantics and first-party set handling for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetAccessSemantics
methods.description: Returns the access semantics for a given cookie based on expectations.

methods.name: ShouldIgnoreSameSiteRestrictions
methods.description: Determines if same-site restrictions should be ignored for a given URL and site context.

methods.name: ComputeFirstPartySetMetadataMaybeAsync
methods.description: Computes first-party set metadata asynchronously or synchronously based on internal flag.

methods.name: FindFirstPartySetEntry
methods.description: Finds a first-party set entry for a given site.

methods.name: FindFirstPartySetEntries
methods.description: Finds multiple first-party set entries for a set of sites.

methods.name: RunMaybeAsync
methods.description: Helper template to run callbacks asynchronously or return result directly.

methods.name: SetExpectationForCookieDomain
methods.description: Sets expected access semantics for a specific cookie domain.

methods.name: SetIgnoreSameSiteRestrictionsScheme
methods.description: Configures whether to ignore same-site restrictions for a scheme.

methods.name: GetKeyForDomainValue
methods.description: Generates a key for a domain value used in expectations.

methods.name: SetFirstPartySets
methods.description: Sets the internal first-party set mapping.
